title: Average velocity forces an instant · Set 3
statement:
A smooth position function moves from 12 m at time 1 s to $12+[$a]$ m at time 5 s. Find the velocity guaranteed at some intermediate instant.

[__________]{a}
hints: Average velocity is displacement over elapsed time.
MVT guarantees the same instantaneous slope somewhere inside.
solution: The displacement is $[$a]$ m, so the guaranteed velocity is $[$a]/4$ m/s.

feedback.message: MVT guarantees the same instantaneous slope somewhere inside.
